_about: Word's name-keyed behavioural substitutions for a missing font name (resolve.ts substituteFor, after the fontTable charset / altName steps and before the Arabic code page, script and Calibri/Cambria fallbacks). Rules run in order; the first whose match (a regex source tested against the NFKC lower-cased declared name, or a ref to a pattern of resolve.ts) hits names the face Word lays out with. Every row cites the Word probe or corpus observation that established it (word-truths.md).
